description: We are a motivated and collaborative team interested in learning, building, and solving real-world problems together. We value creativity, communication, and teamwork, and we are excited to work with people who bring new ideas and perspectives.
summary:
Field Shift (Aboho) is a climate-informed decision-support platform that helps rice farmers in Bangladesh understand how monsoon rainfall is changing. We built a system that uses NASA POWER daily rainfall and temperature for 12 districts (2001-2025) and cross-checks rainfall with NASA GPM IMERG satellite estimates. It tests whether the start of usable monsoon rain has shifted between 2001-2012 and 2013 onwards, using a Mann-Whitney test with multiple-testing correction. The result becomes a simple planting-window advisory for the selected crop, along with a crop-rotation comparison, in Bangla and English with a short SMS version.

This addresses the Field Shift challenge by turning NASA Earth observation data into farming decisions, so farmers don’t need to read complicated climate charts. It matters because rainfall timing affects land preparation, transplanting and irrigation. Aboho shows its evidence, uncertainty and limitations, and it supports farmers’ own knowledge and local agricultural experts instead of replacing them.
details: Field Shift bridges NASA Earth observation data and local agronomy to support climate-resilient farming in Bangladesh. Using two NASA datasets, NASA POWER daily rainfall and temperature for 12 districts (2001-2025) and GPM IMERG ~10 km precipitation estimates for cross-checking rainfall, Field Shift analyses whether the start of usable monsoon rain has shifted over time. It turns that evidence into a transparent planting-window advisory for rice (Aman, with Aus as experimental) and compares candidate crop rotations using simple, documented rules. The platform gives farmers clear seasonal guidance in Bangla and English, with the evidence, uncertainty and limitations explained. It supports farmer judgment and local agricultural expertise, and does not predict yield or profit.
